question: Can I afford a Goa trip next weekend?
headline: Doable if you skip club nights until payday (Sun 01 Nov). That keeps you above your Rs 10,000 safety cushion.

tradeoffs: Skip club nights until payday (Sun 01 Nov): saves ~Rs 6,513 (forecast for the 23 days left)
Still going out before payday: SIP Rs 3,000 (Sat 10 Oct), SIP Rs 2,000 (Thu 15 Oct), phone bill Rs 299 (Thu 15 Oct) and subscription Rs 199 (Tue 20 Oct)
